name: B10-0557/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text:
This resolution does not change any law. It gives the European Parliament's opinion on a citizens' petition called "My Voice, My Choice", which asked for EU money for abortion services. Parliament says abortion policy is a matter for each member state alone, under the EU treaties. It therefore sees no need for new EU action or laws on this, and it questions whether the request respects the principle that the EU only acts where member states cannot.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its opinion.
- It affects the petition organisers and anyone seeking EU funding for abortion services.
- The resolution goes to the Council and the Commission; no new EU law is proposed.
